improvements.reason: The official C# SDK advertises its implemented logging capability. Keep that truthful SDK capability rather than forking the SDK or stripping a supported protocol feature to imitate the Python SDK.

Pre-session authentication failures use the same channel error code/message/retryable family as every other channel boundary. Authentication is still refused with 401; no application fact or authorization decision changes.

The counted cohort contains person-derived rows. Identify cohort as person-only so model-facing consumers cannot mistake it for narration input. The authorized first-party facts and every calculated value remain unchanged.

Preserve the application envelope's person-only findings marker: instance findings can identify an employee in their evidence. This metadata protects model-facing lane projection without changing the authorized first-party findings.

A request whose identity and correlation have already been verified keeps that correlation on the 413 response. This removes an observability inconsistency without accepting the oversized body or dispatching a capability.

The rendered boolean cell uses the JSON spelling true instead of Python str(bool)'s True. Both describe the same proposed requires_decision boolean; the typed preview is unchanged and no figure differs.

The inherited lane check refuses a non-writer Cowork reader when the new bridge correctly marks a person-derived cohort. Prefer the documented person-lane safety rule to leaking rows. This registers only the error flag, not missing facts or any numeric difference; the authorization-policy tension remains explicitly needs_human.

The existing application findings renderer marks person-derived findings, so its inherited lane check refuses a non-writer Cowork reader. Preserve that fail-closed design. Only the error flag is registered: the missing result and authorization-policy tension stay visible for owner review.
